entities.summary: Oshae Jahve Brissett is a Canadian professional basketball player for Maccabi Tel Aviv of the Israeli Ligat HaAl and the EuroLeague. He played college basketball in Division I for the Syracuse Orange for two years before signing with the Toronto Raptors as an undrafted free agent in 2019 and the Indiana Pacers in 2021. Brissett joined the Boston Celtics in 2023, where he won his first NBA championship in 2024.
